correctness.rationale: Exact proof: group-algebra local decomposition yields T_(2^a)=J_(2^(a-1)) twice; each twice-odd cycle has two zero size-one blocks and nonzero size-two spectral blocks. Root equality forces common cyclic roots; the transverse 0-primary contribution is four J1 plus 4(g-1) J2. Frobenius-coordinate Jordan fusion creates exactly 16g-8 length-2^(a-1) zero blocks and no others; the binary off-diagonal rank and flat Schmidt spectrum follow. Independent direct bit-rank physical graph checks passed 17 triples and full-adjacency power ranks passed 10 triples including every tested nilpotence depth.
